notes.title: ver:0.208(demo)update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Know-All here.
﻿
The Steam Next Fest is coming in June, so I've made some optimizations and updates.
﻿
First up—term descriptions.
﻿
https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10289757961203296384/93862FF9D35BDA46D8430A2F537D083E00D7C63A/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false﻿

Just hover your mouse over the question mark to see detailed effects. Super convenient!
[strike]Haha, though writing all these descriptions and commands was painful for me[/strike]
﻿
Next—a small timer for Night Escape.
﻿
https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13139331083407793599/4BC800C98B0B1A9315210584D88DFDAC8157C798/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
﻿
Pretty neat, right?
﻿
Then there are various miscellaneous updates:
﻿
Improved display of enemy movement recovery time after choosing to flee from battle
﻿
Added falling leaves and fireflies in forest and caves
﻿
Enhanced lighting effects during nighttime
﻿
Fixed many soft-lock bugs
﻿
Slight skill buffs 
﻿
Holding S key now skips dialogues faster
...and so on.
﻿
Special thanks to the Drill Up plugin.
Of course, Soul Mirror Relics uses many other plugins too, but since it's still in beta,
I might add or remove plugins later. I'll give proper credits in the full release.
﻿
Finally, while we've listed contact info on the Steam page, it's quite small there,
so let me post it again here:
﻿
QQ Group: 875474910 - Soul Mirror Relics RPG Discussion/Bug Reporting
Steam Group: https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/gu5hfTrt - For discussions or bug reports
﻿
That's all for now. Wishing you success in the relics, Fulan.

notes.title: v0.206(demo) update
notes.notes:
Most of the skill animations for currently implemented characters and the enemy animations in the first and second chapters have been replaced from RPGMAKER's built-resource animations with self-made animations.

This is still a very early-stage work, and changes may or may not be made in the future.

video: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Dx5szkEyK/?vd_source=b9fa722d5510808a5ed8d3b56bf26f7b

notes.title: v0.205 (demo) update:
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where some small descriptions in the enemy bestiary exceeded the dialogue box in the English version. If you still find any text overflow issues in the English version of the game, please let me know.

Currently brainstorming for Day 3 and preparing to redraw the game cover.

notes.title: Version 0.201 (demo) update:
notes.notes:
The map for Day 2 - The Inn has been completely redrawn, and additional "mouths" will appear on the ground, dealing damage to characters, but not fatal... well, mostly not!

To keep track of the version number, the current version will now be prompted at the start of a new game - 0. (0. for beta versions, 1. for official releases) 2 (the current day updated to) 01 (the number of updates).
